info.bio:
Después de la disolución de los Bauhaus su cantante, Peter Murphy, inició una carrera en solitario.Los tres miembros restantes Daniel Ash , David Jay  y  Kevin Haskins formaron en 1985 Love & Rockets, desarrollando una solida trayectoria con un buen puñado de álbumes y numerosos singles.

Con Ash en guitarra y voz, David Jay en bajo y voz ,y Haskins en batería, la banda lanza su primer disco, "Seventh Dream Of Teenage Heaven", en 1985, con un par de temas que lograron difusión radiofónica

scenes.name: Revival psicodélico y garage de los ochenta
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El revival más persistente de los ochenta y noventa. En Los Ángeles, el «Paisley Underground»: Rain Parade, Three O'Clock, Dream Syndicate (síntesis de Dylan y la Velvet), Savage Republic, True West, Opal. En la Costa Este, los imitadores fetichistas (Lyres, Fuzztones, Chesterfield Kings) y bandas creativas (Das Damen, Plasticland, Eleventh Dream Day). El garage más crudo: Honeymoon Killers, Gibson Bros, Gories, Original Sins, God Bullies, Pandoras. La psicodelia libre de jams: Crystallized Movements, Magic Hour, Vocokesh, Sun City Girls, Black Sun Ensemble, Helios Creed. En Australia, Celibate Rifles, Died Pretty, Hoodoo Gurus, Beasts Of Bourbon, Scientists, Feedtime, Crime And The City Solution; en Europa, Hanoi Rocks, Echo & The Bunnymen, Teardrop Explodes, Bevis Frond, Legendary Pink Dots, The The y Love And Rockets.

podcast.body: This band was formed by members of Bauhaus after the original group's splintering. "Bauhaus splintered into tones on tail and loving rockets"

podcast.title: Commercial Success - Beyond Bauhaus
podcast.body: Love and Rockets achieved greater commercial success than Bauhaus, selling millions of records globally, headlining large tours, and securing a Top 40 hit in America. "As Love in Rockets, Daniel Ash, David J and Kevin Haskins were far more successful than Bajaos could have ever been, selling millions of records around the world, playing huge headlined tours and even having a top 40 hit in America."

podcast.title: Mid-90s Challenges
podcast.body: By the mid-1990s, Love and Rockets encountered financial and professional difficulties, described as having "fallen on hard times." "Love in Rockets had fallen on hard times."

podcast.title: Name Origin
podcast.body: The band's name was inspired by a comic book titled "Love and Rockets," which was noticed by a member during their search for a new name. "Now all they needed was a name. That's when someone noticed the name of a comic book. A comic book called Love in Rockets."

podcast.title: Post-Bauhaus Success
podcast.body: Formed by Daniel Ash, David J, and Kevin Haskins after Peter Murphy declined a Bauhaus reunion, Love and Rockets achieved greater commercial success than Bauhaus. They sold millions of records worldwide, headlined large tours, and secured a Top 40 hit in America. "Daniel Ash, David J and Kevin Haskins were far more successful than Bajaos could have ever been selling millions of records around the world, playing huge headline tours, and even having a top 40 hit in America."

srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Bauhaus?

xref.title: Love and Rockets' Success
xref.body: Love and Rockets, the successor band, achieved substantial success, including the single "So Alive," which reached number one in Canada and number three on the U.S. Top 40 charts. "And they had a really good run with many big singles, including So Alive, which was a number one single in Canada and a number three single in the U.S. and I'm talking the Tom Fordy Charts."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest All-Time Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders: Part 1

xref.title: Post-Breakup Projects
xref.body: After the band Bauhaus "splintered," its members went on to form other significant groups, including Tones on Tail and Love and Rockets. Additionally, the individual members, Peter Murphy, David J, and Daniel Ash, pursued solo careers. "Bauhaus splintered into tones on tail and loving rockets and indirectly gave us Peter Murphy, David J and Daniel Ash."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Very First Episode of the Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Reconstitution as Love and Rockets
xref.body: After Tones on Tail ceased activity, the group was reconstituted under the name Love and Rockets, which featured the members of Bauhaus with the exception of singer Peter Murphy. This new iteration went on to have a successful run with multiple significant singles. "When Tons on Tale Lost Steam, the group was reconstituted under the name Love and Rockets, which was Bajaos minus singer Peter Murphy."
